title: fix(tui): scroll PR list on mouse wheel without Y hit-test [held-out: broken-parent / revert-of-fix]
author: madicen
body:
This change ensures that the PR list scrolls correctly even when the mouse wheel event reports a Y coordinate outside the visible area of the list widget. It addresses issues where the terminal's own scrollback took over instead of scrolling the list.

- Fixed handling of mouse wheel events outside the list bounds
- Ensured cursor movement in the list regardless of Y position
- Updated tests to cover new behavior
